MSC-180/34_002.formal_statement: theorem potential_function_exact_ode {f g : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g) : ∃ (F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (C : ℝ), Differentiable ℝ F ∧ (∀ (x y : ℝ), deriv (λ x' => F (x', y)) x = f x) ∧ (∀ (x y : ℝ), deriv (λ y' => F (x, y')) y = g y) ∧ (∀ (x y : ℝ), F (x, y) = ∫ t in 0..x, f t + ∫ t in 0..y, g t + C) := by sorry

MSC-180/34_003.formal_statement: theorem brine_tank_system {V r : ℝ} (hV : V > 0) (hr : r > 0) : ∀ (x₁ x₂ : ℝ → ℝ), (Differentiable ℝ x₁) → (Differentiable ℝ x₂) → (∀ t, deriv x₁ t = r / V * (x₂ t - x₁ t)) ∧ (∀ t, deriv x₂ t = r / V * (x₁ t - x₂ t)) := by sorry

MSC-180/39_003.formal_statement: theorem power_series_recurrence_relation (C : ℕ → ℝ) (R : ℝ) (hR : R > 0) (hconv : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball 0 R, HasSum (λ n => C n * x ^ n) (∑' n, C n * x ^ n)) (hsol : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball 0 R, deriv^[2] (fun x => ∑' n, C n * x ^ n) x + 3 * x * deriv (fun x => ∑' n, C n * x ^ n) x + 3 * (∑' n, C n * x ^ n) = 0) : ∀ k ≥ 2, k * C k + 3 * C (k - 2) = 0 := by sorry

MSC-180/78_003.header:
import Mathlib
open Real
variable (q l r ε₀ : ℝ)
variable (hl : l > 0) (hr : r > 2 * l) (hε₀ : ε₀ > 0)
noncomputable def quadrupole_moment : ℝ := 2 * q * l^2
noncomputable def quadrupole_field_strength : ℝ := 3 * quadrupole_moment q l / (4 * π * ε₀ * r^4)
MSC-180/78_003.formal_statement: theorem quadrupole_field_theorem : quadrupole_field_strength q l r ε₀ = 3 * (2 * q * l^2) / (4 * π * ε₀ * r^4) := by sorry

MSC-180/91_003.formal_statement: theorem war_stage_nash_equilibria : let game := war_stage_payoff; let equilibria := { (s₁, s₂) | (s₁ = ![1, 0] ∧ s₂ = ![1, 0]) ∨ (s₁ = ![0, 1] ∧ s₂ = ![0, 1]) }; (∀ (s : _ × _), s ∈ equilibria → IsPureNashEquilibrium game s.1 s.2) ∧ (PureStrategyPayoff game ![1, 0] ![1, 0] = (-5, -5)) ∧ (PureStrategyPayoff game ![0, 1] ![0, 1] = (-100, -100)) := by sorry
